stem: Which quotation provides the best evidence that most people were not familiar with automobiles in 1903?

options.label: A
options.text: At that time, new cars were preordered directly from the manufacturer. (paragraph 3)

options.label: B
options.text: The car had 1,000 miles and worn tires, but the owner agreed to sell it—for $500 more than he had originally paid. (paragraph 3)

options.label: C
options.text: On dry days, even Bud needed goggles to keep road dust out of his eyes. (paragraph 5)

options.label: D
options.text: One newspaper encouraged readers to arrive early for a good view, in case the vehicle flew by at 90 miles per hour. (paragraph 8)
